data.name: BRODUCE
data.detailed_description:
BRODUCE is a 3D platforming adventure game. You play as a BRODUCE. A strange creature you can customize to reflect your own fruitiness. A huge universe can be explored offline or online with friends.

A galaxy full of people who think their problems were too big for someone as small as you. Can you prove them wrong?

Fix all their problems by using the gifts that you collect along the way. Gifts give you abilities that help you navigate the environment and solve puzzles. You collect gifts and tickets as you explore the universe. You can trade tickets for gifts and other helpful items. Compete in various mini-games to earn tickets and other prizes. Tickets are also hidden around the many planets you will visit.  

Be careful though! You have limited resources, so make sure you have enough stuff for your adventure!

Play single-player or multiplayer.  BRODUCE will have certain features that are only available online. To be announced soon!

BRODUCE is created by AsFunAsFun, a small team of two from Maine, USA.

DRM Free. Generative AI was not used at any point in the making of this game.

Minimum:

  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 support, x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 support, ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 support, x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 support, ARMv8 CPU
